normalized.result:
The duplicate-handling logic and normalization now match my intent.

There is one presentation mismatch to correct before settling it: the “Edit existing” form shows tags as a comma-separated field and the note as a plain box. It should use the tag pills with matching past-tag suggestions and the formatted-note editor with live preview that we already chose. Editing through the duplicate flow should feel and behave exactly like editing the bookmark normally.
